Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From e46b5a6470a5e2c8e1096f8f60887ac19949055b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Shawn Guo <shawn.guo@linaro.org>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2015 22:06:41 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] ARM: dts: fix imx27 dtb build rule

The i.MX27 dtb build should be controlled by CONFIG_SOC_IMX27 rather
than CONFIG_SOC_IMX31.

Signed-off-by: Shawn Guo <shawn.guo@linaro.org>
Fixes: cb612390e546 ("ARM: dts: Only build dtb if associated Arch and/or SoC is enabled")
Cc: <stable@vger.kernel.org>

diff --git a/arch/arm/boot/dts/Makefile b/arch/arm/boot/dts/Makefile
index 86217db2937a..992736b5229b 100644
--- a/arch/arm/boot/dts/Makefile
+++ b/arch/arm/boot/dts/Makefile
@@ -223,7 +223,7 @@ dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX25) += \
 	imx25-eukrea-mbimxsd25-baseboard-dvi-vga.dtb \
 	imx25-karo-tx25.dtb \
 	imx25-pdk.dtb
-dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX31) += \
+dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX27) += \
 	imx27-apf27.dtb \
 	imx27-apf27dev.dtb \
 	imx27-eukrea-mbimxsd27-baseboard.dtb \
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `arch/arm/boot/dts/Makefile`**
   - The line that previously added device tree blobs (dtbs) for the i.MX31 SoC has been modified. Specifically, the line:
     ```make
     dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX31) += \
     ```
     has been changed to:
     ```make
     dtb-$(CONFIG_SOC_IMX27) += \
     ```
   - This change ensures that the device tree blobs for the i.MX27 are built when the configuration option `CONFIG_SOC_IMX27` is enabled, rather than when `CONFIG_SOC_IMX31` is enabled.

### Relationships

- The modification in the `Makefile` directly addresses a bug related to the incorrect configuration option being used to control the build of the i.MX27 device tree blobs. The patch corrects this by linking the build rule to the appropriate configuration option (`CONFIG_SOC_IMX27`), thereby ensuring that the correct device tree files are built for the i.MX27 SoC. This change is part of a broader effort to ensure that device tree builds are accurately tied to their respective SoC configurations, as indicated by the referenced fix in the commit message.
